name: web-finance-landing-page-overview-on-pearl-grey-gradient-with-two-columns
title: Long pearl-grey finance site shown in two columns: hero with phone, bento features, reviews, pricing, app download and image footer
whatItIs: A lilac-grey board with '10 Landing page' and a serif headline 'A Landing Page Designed for Modern Finance.' Beside it two tall pages: a hero with serif headline and pearl phones, logo strip, an about paragraph, a bento of six frosted feature tiles, work-anywhere photos; and a second column with four icon columns, reviews with portraits, three pricing plans with a highlighted middle, a hand-held app section with QR and a landscape footer with a giant wordmark.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; a pearl palette with serif makes finance feel refined.
techniques: Use serif headings on pearl gradients.
Present features in frosted bento tiles.
Highlight one pricing plan with a warm gradient.
End with a landscape photo footer and wordmark.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of translucent rounded tiles.
Two long pages shown side by side.
A pricing card with a warm gradient.
